title: Great way to get holiday spirit!
text: Great way to get holiday spirit!. This is a super cute way to decorate for the holidays. I put these in the windows (including the front door glass) and it makes the house look so cute from the outside. Being that I live in Florida, I love the snow flakes adorning the glass. These are easy to apply and easy to remove. Highly recommend as a cheap addition to adding holiday accents to your home.
